name: WageRecords
description: Payrolls, wage books and account entries that record what a named person earned for work in a given period.

contains_no_content_of_requested_type.description: Set to true if the input text contains no wage records. Otherwise, set to false.

person.description: The name of the person paid, as written. Example: 'John Carter'.

occupation.description: The trade or position of the person. Example: 'mason' or 'day labourer'. Use null if not stated.

wage.description: The amount paid as a decimal number. Use null if the amount is illegible or missing.

period.description: The period the wage covers, as written. Example: 'per day', 'per week' or 'for the quarter'. Use null if not stated.

currency.description: The currency or monetary unit as written. Use null if not stated.

date.description: The date of payment or of the work, as written. Use null if the source gives no date.

employer.description: The person or institution that paid the wage. Use null if not stated.

source_page.description: The page or folio on which the entry appears. Use null if not identifiable.

notes.description: Remarks about the entry, such as payment in kind or an uncertain reading. Use null if there are none.
